caption: The drawing depicts a wooden writing desk with a slanted front that opens outward to form a flat writing surface. The exterior of the desk and drawers is colored in a reddish-brown wood grain pattern. There are three large horizontal drawers with small, round, dark brown knobs and keyholes at the center of each drawer. When opened, the writing surface reveals an interior compartment with multiple small drawers and pigeonholes. The interior wood is a lighter, yellowish-brown color compared to the exterior, with darker wood knobs on the small drawers. Above the drawers inside, there are four small compartments with curved openings. The desk stands on short, turned legs. The drawing is centered on a plain, off-white background, and the name "Eugene Cros" is written in cursive in the lower right corner.
title: Desk
